audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Ragnarok makes you 'immune to his slows' and 'speeds you through his kite'. Lucian has no slow anywhere in his kit — Q, W, E and R carry no slow flag and none of Riot's four descriptions mentions one — and Ragnarok's text grants armour, MR and disable immunity, never move speed. His kite comes from Ardent Blaze, which grants HIM move speed for attacking marked enemies. Separately, Relentless Pursuit is described as 'his dash + reset' with no number: it is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, but Riot's own text adds 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown'.
audit.why: Both errors point the player at the wrong plan for level 6. Ragnarok is not a chase tool in this matchup — there is nothing to cleanse and no speed — it is armour, MR and gank insurance, which is why it lets you eat a Culling and keep swinging. And a player told to 'engage when his dash is down' will count 16 seconds on a stopwatch while Lucian refunds it with every double-shot; the correct read is to count his Lightslinger procs, not the clock.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[1].text, phases[4].why, content.mid and wants.you[1] rewritten to state what Ragnarok actually provides here. The 16s and the Lightslinger refund written into dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: focus.text and a dozen strings key the lane to Relentless Pursuit's cooldown, which Lucian partially refunds on demand. The Culling at 110/100/90s is the cooldown that is actually worth waiting out.
audit.why: A cooldown the enemy controls the length of is not a window.

edits.after: This is where it flips to you. Once you have Q plus E your all-in beats his — land the axe, the slow sticks, you walk in and E's true damage ignores his lack of resistances. At 6, be clear about what Ragnarok does: he has no slow to cleanse and it grants no speed. What it gives you is armour and MR to eat a Culling and immunity to any disable while you keep swinging. Bait his E — 16s at rank 1 — then commit.

notes: Biggest single finding: Lucian has no slow. Four strings across both layers told the player Ragnarok makes them 'immune to his slows', and two of those also credited it with move speed. Riot's Ragnarok text grants armour, MR and disable immunity while attacking, and none of Lucian's four abilities slows — Ardent Blaze grants the move speed, to him. That turned the level-6 plan into a chase fantasy. The ratings were the other real problem: 2/10 on five rows in a 51.43% lane over a 2236-game sample, the largest in my slice, while the prose on the same rows described Olaf winning. Left alone: whether Undertow's derived grounding flag would deny Relentless Pursuit — Riot's Undertow text mentions only damage, armour reduction and move-speed reduction, and the mirror agent hit the same wall. If that flag is real it is a significant line for this matchup specifically, since Relentless Pursuit is his only dash.
